You are the new traffic mayor. Your goal: earn money for the town coffers, look good, and don't get recalled. The mouse wheel zooms, dragging moves the map. Space stops time.
Wählen Sie unten das Werkzeug „Tempolimi: Pick the "Speed limit" tool at the bottom – 30 is already selected – and click on a big road with lots of traffic. The limit applies from junction to junction.
Where there's a limit, there can be a camera. Take "Speed camera" and click on the same road. A fixed camera is expensive, but earns money day and night.
Taste 4 schaltet auf achtfaches Tempo. S: Key 4 switches to eight times the speed. As soon as the first speeder is flashed, the till rings – fines are shown at the top left.
Oben links stehen auch Bürgerzorn, Abwah: Citizen anger, recall index and reputation are also shown at the top left. Too much harassment and the recall index rises – at 100 you're out of office. The "Satisfaction" button shows where it's simmering.
Öffnen Sie oben rechts „Haushalt & PR“ u: Open "Budget & PR" at the top right and sign a PR contract. The paper will write more kindly, and citizens' anger counts for less.
Jetzt ist alles frei: Ampeln, mobile Bli: Now everything is unlocked: traffic lights, mobile cameras, priority roads, bike crossings and detours. Traffic lights slow traffic reliably, detours annoy everyone. What each symbol means is under "Legend ?".
Lassen Sie den Tag zu Ende laufen (nacht: Let the day run to its end (night time passes faster by itself). In the evening you get the end-of-day report, the next morning the newspaper.
Der Rest der Amtszeit gehört Ihnen. Viel: The rest of the term is yours. Good luck – and always think of the safety of our children.
